title: Sharp approximate Carathéodory theorem and application to iterated Delaunay refinement
summary: We analyze the decrease of simplex diameters under iterated refinement of spherical Delaunay complexes. Unlike in ordinary subdivision, the refined Delaunay complex need not be a subdivision of the previous one, so mesh contraction is not automatic. We derive explicit contraction bounds for several families of Steiner points, including Delaunay analogues of barycentric and edgewise subdivision.
